prompt: Evan applied the Held status in Pine but then opened Cedar before recording. How can he still capture a clip showing that order in Held?
promptZh: Evan 在松木中將訂單標為「暫緩」，卻在錄影前先打開了雪松。他要如何補錄，才能讓片段顯示該筆訂單為「暫緩」？

options.text: Open Replay, stop at the first rush, and change the order to Held.
options.zh: 進入重播，在第一波尖峰暫停，再把訂單改成「暫緩」。
options.whyZh: 暫停重播不會開放編輯，第一波尖峰也屬於另一段影片。

options.text: Resume Pine and rely on the previous Held edit still being there.
options.zh: 回到松木，使用仍留在畫面上的原「暫緩」變更。
options.whyZh: 切換到雪松已捨棄原情境的變更，回去不能依賴原先的狀態。

options.text: Use the live dashboard because the fictional order is no longer editable.
options.zh: 因為不能再編輯這筆虛構訂單，改錄即時儀表板。
options.whyZh: Evan 說兩段都不能用即時儀表板；預覽的虛構訂單仍可以再次編輯。

options.text: Open Pine again, make the status change in Preview, and record it before switching.
options.zh: 重新開啟松木，在預覽中再改一次狀態，切換前錄下。
options.whyZh: 原變更已因切換情境而遺失；預覽允許再改，應在改換情境前拍下畫面。

explanationZh: 原變更已因切換情境而遺失；預覽允許再改，應在改換情境前拍下畫面。
evidence: You can change their status to demonstrate the editing controls. / If you select a different preview scenario, the edits from the previous scenario are discarded. / Use the Pine preview first. / Choose the new status, then record the revised row before you open the Cedar preview.

vocabulary.note: 指供示範使用的一組虛構訂單與操作環境。
